grid_master_source_sheet.sheet_name: แปลนฐานรากแผ่
grid_master_source_sheet.reason: First structural plan sheet in the set (per README precedence: structural S-sheets always win grid geometry). It is also where the printed dimension chain is cleanest/least obstructed by other annotations. Both axes' full chains are printed here and repeat identically on S-03/S-04/S-05/A-04 (cross-checked): x-axis (grids 1-2-3-4) = 3.20 + 3.20 + 3.20 = 9.60 m; y-axis (grids F-E-D-C-B-A) = 4.00 + 2.00 + 3.60 + 1.80 + 3.15 = 14.55 m.
grid_master_source_sheet.flag_dummy_grids: S-02 and S-03 both show 2 extra footings (F0.80x0.80 marked C1A on S-02 / pile caps marked C1A on S-03) positioned off the main grid, between column-lines 2 and 3, roughly at row B and row A. These will very likely need dummy grid lines (per schema §4 beam-endpoint rule) - Stage 1 must resolve their exact pos_m from the printed local dimensions, not guess. Flagging here since Stage 0 only read the overview, not zoomed dimensions for these two off-grid points.

buildings.note: Single rectangular footprint (9.60m x 14.55m), single grid system (1-4 / A-F) used consistently across A-04, A-05, S-02 through S-05 - no evidence of a second physically separate building (e.g. no detached utility/toilet block referenced anywhere in the saraban or the sheets read). This is a simple 1-story 3-bedroom house per the cover page (3 ห้องนอน 2 ห้องน้ำ). §11a multi-building handling is NOT needed for this house.

open_flags_for_stage1_and_stage2: S-02/S-03 off-grid footings (F0.80x0.80 / pile cap, mark C1A, between grid 2-3, near row A/B) need dummy grid lines added to the grid master per schema §4 beam-endpoint rule - Stage 0 did not zoom in to read their exact local dimensions.

Pages หน้า13 through หน้า21 (A-11 to A-19, door/bathroom/stair/fence detail enlargements) and หน้า28 (S-06 roof framing plan), หน้า30 through หน้า35 (S-08 to S-13, column schedule + footing/stair detail enlargements) were classified from the สารบัญ index text only, NOT verified by direct image read this Stage 0 session (time-boxed to grid-critical pages per the README's Stage 0 scope). Stage 2 must re-derive their actual pattern from the real page content rather than trusting this manifest's placeholder pattern label.

SN/EE/M discipline pages (หน้า37-49) and both BOQ blocks (หน้า50-69) were not opened this session - entirely out of Stage 0's scope (grid + plan focus) and are Stage 2 territory per the README's 4-stage table.

หน้า01 classified pattern:misc (cover render) rather than title - per schema §13 pattern 13, this is a whole-series-style promotional cover, consistent with 'misc' precedent from other houses in this set (บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย 7 series, sibling houses 01-03/05-07 likely share the exact same cover/index/regulation boilerplate pages).
